description: Anonymous integer ID of the person who gave the rating (1-500 after cleaning). No name, contact or demographic attribute is stored, so the data contains no PII.
Integer key of the film in data/movie_catalog.csv (1-62). ADDED during cleaning - not present in the supplied dataset.csv, which only had movie_title.

English title of the film. One title maps to exactly one movie_id, genre, language and release_year (the supplied file had up to 6 genres / 4 languages / 15 years per title; these were repaired from the catalogue).
Primary genre of the film: Action, Comedy, Drama, Romance, Sci-Fi or Thriller (one genre per film). Taken from the canonical catalogue.
Original-release language of the film: Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada or Malayalam. Used for diversity / regional-exposure metrics, NOT as a model input (models are pure collaborative filtering).
Calendar year the film was first released (2003-2024).
Rating given by the user on a 1.0-5.0 scale in 0.5 steps (5.0 = best). Ratings >= 4.0 count as 'relevant' in ranking evaluation. Rows outside 1-5 were removed during cleaning.
When the rating was made; range 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-01, sorted ascending. Rows originating from the supplied dataset.csv only had a date, so their time is 00:00:00.
